From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-09-07T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo invite for Thu 9/9 — join button missing

Jasmine — on it. Quick notes:

1) Root cause: the original invite was generated by our hosted calendar proxy, then forwarded by a third-party calendar sync. The forwarding stripped the X-ALT-JOIN anchor I normally embed. Outlook imported the invite fine but the join URL field ended up blank.

2) Proposed fix (minimal user impact):
   - Create a new invite from the demo-host@redwood-demo.com account (we own the calendar entry).
   - Add Zoom join URL + PSTN dial-in block in the body (explicit URL + dial-in lines).
   - Set organizer to demo-host so clients see a consistent owner and accept flow (prevents delegate aliasing).
   - Attach regenerated-invite.ics for customers who prefer to import.

3) Checklist for today: regenerate ICS (I will attach), Jasmine to resend and confirm recipients, Nora to confirm Zoom vs Meet preference.

I attached a regenerated ICS with explicit join text — this one includes both the Zoom link and dial-in lines in the description so Outlook clients keep it even if the anchor gets scrubbed.

Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
